steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I can't believe Reunion here is so tough. Hmph, I won't lose to you!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tch, this silly girl.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Wake up!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Hm? Where am I?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Oh, it's Gavial! Everyone else too!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Ehehe. Good morning, Doctor.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Um, Doctor looks a little scary right now. Did I do something wrong?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Doctor, please don't be mad...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Hnng... Doctor, that hurt.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Why did you bop me on the head...?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Looks like she's back to her senses, at least.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Kay, do you remember how you got here?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Umm... I forgot!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Come lie down, I'll check and see if there's anything wrong with you. Don't run off again.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Okay~ Ehh, where are we?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: We're... Hm, it's a long story. Just lie down already!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Ooh—

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Gavial, what the hell are you doing?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ugh, that's a long story too. Just let me work.
Ten minutes later...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright, everything looks okay. Go wait with the Doctor and don't wander off. If you do it again, it's no more honey biscuits for you.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Okay! Honey biscuits!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Are you done?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm done.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: So now can you tell me what the hell you're doing, Gavial?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: *Sigh*, I said it's a long story. Short version is I'm here to look for you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're not getting the engine back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That too. But there's another reason I'm looking for you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Another reason?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Do you have your people mining ore?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: ...Tch.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Gavial, I never took you for the sore loser type.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Are you that broken up about being beaten by the Big, Ugly Thing?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: No, your Big Ugly Whatever is great. I'm totally fine with that.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But if you're putting your people at risk of Oripathy infection for the sake of some ore, then as a doctor I have no choice but to stop you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Huh? Oripathy? Oh, you're talking about Stone Disease.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I'm not putting anyone at risk.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I told them many times to stay away from the depths of the mine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But your people are getting infected!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: There's always someone who doesn't listen. I can't control them all. Isn't that right, Yogi?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Yes, my brother wanted to dig out more ore for the Great Chief, so he went deeper into the mine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Why didn't you say so earlier?!

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: You didn't ask.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's pretty important...!

options: You told me they don't take Oripathy seriously here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Agh, fine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, did I really not ask?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Agh, Doctor, take my side here!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Also...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, why are you taking your clothes off?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Your body...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I've been running around the mine ever since I was a kid. It's only natural I would get the Stone Disease.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I dare say no one knows better than me where the diseased rocks are.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: All right then.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: My mistake. Sorry for accusing you, Zumama.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It's fine.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Eh, that's all it took?! We're all good now?!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Isn't everybody supposed to stubbornly stick to their guns until we all end up in one big honkin' battle?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya shouldn't hope fer stuff like that!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Then let's talk about the other thing.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You have our engine, don't you?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Can you return that to us? We can't leave without it.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: If you want to leave, I can have someone escort you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: No good. Kal'tsit will get mad.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You won't hand it over no matter what?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: No matter what.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, looks like we're gonna fight after all.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Looks like it.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: That was the plan from the very beginning.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, are we fighting that? Fun!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Hello, nice to meet you!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...High Priest, why did you bring the Big Ugly out?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Huh? Aren't we going to fight Gavial? Do we not need it? If not, I'll drive it back. I still want to test the engine.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...We need it, but not now. I still have something to say.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, alright. You have your talk first then. Call me when you want to fight!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, what was that about an engine?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: That's right, your engine is powering the Big Ugly right now. If you want it, you'll have to fight for it.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hehe. Deal!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Come with me. We'll see who comes out on top.
